audit_scope: Regenerated raw values/identities/counts/truth; full inventories, fixed settings, seeds and archived replay; independent PCA raw moments/eigen-equations for source rows and group means, projections/profiles/fusion, selected dense GMM density/BIC/membership; independent ARI/axis checks; bootstrap seeds/source members/draw multiplicities and target-mean PCA parameters, distinct-unit constraints, partitions, exact-set counts, OOB denominators and failure bounds. No model refits. Nonselected GMM and source-row bootstrap PCA parameters are not independently refitted.
interpretation: Prespecified four-arm comparison under constructed laws; unchanged defaults/p-values. K selection without generating discrete groups is descriptive, not a type-I error test or species significance. Wilson intervals are pointwise. Stability is separate from significance and conditions on fixed observed group members.
